name: Elbert County, CO
findings: Elbert County has 97 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 32 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Elbert County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Elbert County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Elbert County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 31 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 9 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 9 social and fraternal organizations here list public events, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.
